title: Reply: detail questions before a contest over the weak notion of self

statements.text: Metzinger replies to Zahavi that a non-conceptual sense of ownership is not present whenever there is phenomenal consciousness, given full depersonalization and certain spiritual experiences, and that the phenomenological case for a pre-reflective self needs arguments and testable predictions. He proposes to study the representational and functional structure of self-consciousness in detail before deciding the appropriate weak notion of self.

sources.quote: I may disagree, however, that it is legitimate to speak of a non-conceptual sense of ownership strictly whenever we are phenomenally conscious
than to get lost in a competition of theories about what the appropriate weak notion of “self” is
